identity.name: Royal Oak Jumbo Extra-Thin
identity.one_liner: The keeper of the 1972 Royal Oak formula — 39mm, 8.1mm, caliber 2121 — retired at the model's 50th birthday.

provenance_events.description: AP confirmed the steel Jumbo 15202ST would leave production in 2022, to make way for a new reference at the Royal Oak's 50th anniversary. Secondary asking prices climbed roughly 50% on the news.

Audemars Piguet releases the 15202ST, the "Jumbo" Extra-Thin — a 39mm case 8.1mm thick, "Petite Tapisserie" dial, 2121 movement. It becomes the closest modern descendant of the 1972 5402ST and the reference against which all other steel APs are measured.

narrative.story: The 15202 existed to keep the original Royal Oak recipe alive: same 39mm x 8.1mm case as the 1972 5402, same ultra-thin caliber 2121, petite tapisserie dial with the AP monogram restored to 6 o'clock in the 2012 revision. From 2000 to 2022 it was the purist's Royal Oak while the rest of the collection grew and multiplied. AP ended it at the 50th anniversary, handing the format to the 16202 and its new caliber 7121.
narrative.collector_notes: The 2121 has no stop-seconds and a delicate date mechanism — never set the date near midnight, and budget for AP-only servicing. 2012-2022 blue-dial examples are the reference market; earlier dial variants and the 'ST.OO' bracelet generations matter to pricing.
